chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Milt on his friendship with Danny
summary: Milt says he and Danny don't have to speak daily, but a phone call with Danny can put his life straight, and Lu agrees friendships must be kept.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: We were playing. And we're the kind of friends that you don't have to be talking to one another every day or seeing one another every day. It's just an understanding. It's an understanding. I know that you know that sometimes I've had something on my mind when we've been separated in New York, and I just couldn't get... I'd give a phone call to Danny and just talk to him for a few minutes, and tell him what's on my mind or how I'm feeling or what's happening with me. And when I talk to him, in a few minutes I can go on back and kind of halfway get my life straight back together. And that's the kind of friend you really need...
And that's the kind of friend I really appreciate you for being, Danny.
Well, this world has problems. Things surprise you. You get surprises...
We have to keep our friendships.
Yes, we have to savor that.
Because we (?) that call(?) a lot!
We mean that. It ain't no foolishness. This is forever!
